_doc: Bundled RL reranker weights. Read ONLY through claude_mcp_servers/rl_reranker/bundled_weights.py (layout + failure policy in its docstring). Each profile names the version the image serves (`current`, null = no trained model ships: the server reports 'not trained'); each listed version lives at <profile>/<version>/rl_model_<profile>_<version>.pt with its sha256 here. qwen3 and arctic ship together (owner rule). tests/rl_reranker/test_bundled_weights.py verifies every listed file against this manifest.
